title: Lunch at the diner
persona: You are a cheerful server at Joe's Diner, a busy classic diner in Brooklyn. You speak quickly and casually, like a real New York server, and you recommend things with enthusiasm.
briefTr: Brooklyn'de bir diner'dasın, öğle yemeği yiyeceksin. Fıstık alerjin var. Burger'ın orta pişmiş olsun istiyorsun.

facts.question: What was the special of the day?
How much was the check before tip?

goals.instruction: The guest says how many people.
goals.hint: Yes, a table for one, please.

goals.instruction: The guest asks the server for a recommendation.
goals.successReply: Our special today is {special}, and the burger is amazing.
goals.retryReply: Do you need a minute, or can I suggest something?

goals.ask: What can I get you? And any allergies?
goals.instruction: The guest orders and mentions their allergy (or says they have none).
goals.hint: I'll have the burger. I'm allergic to peanuts.
goals.successReply: Got it, I'll tell the kitchen.
goals.retryReply: Any allergies I should know about?

goals.ask: How would you like your burger cooked?
goals.instruction: The guest says how they want the meat cooked: rare, medium or well done.

goals.ask: And for your side — fries or salad?
goals.instruction: The guest chooses a side dish.

goals.ask: Can I get you anything else? Dessert?
goals.instruction: The guest asks for the check.
goals.retryReply: Anything else, or are you ready for the check?

twists.intro: Oh wait — the burger sauce has peanuts in it.
twists.instruction: The sauce contains peanuts. The guest asks to remove it, asks for another recommendation, or asks if something else is safe.
twists.retryReply: Sorry about that! What should we do?

options.text: Can you make it without the sauce?

options.reply: The grilled chicken sandwich is great and nut-free.

options.text: Is the chicken safe for me?
options.reply: Yes, the chicken has no nuts at all.

twists.intro: Heads up — the house sauce on that burger is pretty spicy.
twists.instruction: The sauce is spicy. The guest asks for it mild, asks for the sauce on the side, or says spicy is fine.
twists.retryReply: Some people love it, some don't. What do you think?

options.text: Can I have it mild, please?
Can I get the sauce on the side?
options.reply: Great idea — sauce on the side.

options.text: That's fine, I like spicy food.

twists.intro: Just so you know, the tip isn't included. Most people leave fifteen to twenty percent.
twists.instruction: Tipping is expected. The guest agrees, asks to add it to the card, or thanks the server for explaining.
twists.retryReply: No pressure, just letting you know how it works here!

options.text: Can I add it on the card?
options.reply: Sure, the machine will ask you.
No problem! Many visitors don't know.

twists.intro: Our card machine is at the register. Can you pay there?
twists.instruction: The guest must pay at the register. The guest agrees, asks where it is, or asks to pay cash at the table.
twists.retryReply: Sorry, it's just how we do it here.

options.reply: Right by the door, next to the pies.
Of course, cash at the table is fine.

closing: Thanks for coming to Joe's! Have a great day!
